checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicit; content is eligible while statutory use is prohibited.
Three provisional key areas are present, non-overlapping and disclosed.
Land-use polygons are a shared partition of the site with no material gap or overlap.
All nine GeoJSON files contain schema-compliant feature collections.
Design polygons are valid and located inside the provisional site.
All 12 scenario nodes declare risk, privacy, human review and fallback rules.
Core area metrics derive from EPSG:4548 geometry and share one calculation basis.
Every external or repository source declares permitted use and non-use.
Offline static HTML uses only local figures and exact metric markers.
Original contribution and COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY terms are disclosed.
Proposal links tasks, standards, design depth, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions.
